task_description: Write a script to clean up messy data logs.

plan: Identify and remove duplicate log entries
Develop a data cleansing algorithm to handle inconsistent formatting
Implement a data validation process to ensure logs are accurate and complete
final_state.final_code:
import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv('logs.csv')

# Validate data types
for col in data.columns:
    if data[col].dtype == 'object':
        data[col] = data[col].str.strip()
        data[col] = data[col].replace('', pd.NA)
    elif data[col].dtype == 'int64':
        data[col] = pd.to_numeric(data[col], errors='coerce')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = data.isnull().sum()
print(missing_values)

# Handle missing values
data.fillna({'column1': 0, 'column2': 'default'}, inplace=True)
